# Sciencing

> Sciencing is a daily content platform for curious minds, offering accessible science, engineering, and mathematics education through articles spanning biology, chemistry, ecology, and meteorology.

Sciencing provides educational content written by expert contributors covering fundamental scientific concepts and comparisons. The platform serves as a resource for understanding core topics in natural sciences, from atomic structure to marine biology and climate systems.

## Key Topics

- science education
- biology
- chemistry
- ecology
- meteorology
- marine biology
- plankton
- atomic structure
- biomes
- natural sciences
- physics
- environmental science
- educational content
- popular science
- STEM

## Science Education Hub

- [Sciencing: Daily content for curious minds](https://dev.sciencing.com/): Sciencing homepage offering daily science, engineering, and math articles

## Chemistry & Physics

- [Why Is An Atom Electrically Neutral?](https://www.sciencing.com/why-is-an-atom-electrically-neutral-13710231/): Educational guide explaining atomic structure and electrical neutrality basics
- [Sodium Carbonate Vs. Sodium Bicarbonate](https://www.sciencing.com/sodium-carbonate-vs-sodium-bicarbonate-5498788/): Chemistry guide comparing sodium carbonate and sodium bicarbonate uses

## Biology & Marine Science

- [Zooplankton Vs. Phytoplankton](https://www.sciencing.com/zooplankton-vs-phytoplankton-5432413/): Marine biology article comparing zooplankton and phytoplankton characteristics

## Ecology & Environment

- [Taiga Plant Adaptations](https://www.sciencing.com/taiga-plant-adaptation-7895031/): Ecology guide on plant adaptations in taiga and boreal forest biomes
- [Equatorial Air Mass Characteristics](https://www.sciencing.com/equatorial-air-mass-characteristics-17044/): Meteorology guide on equatorial air mass properties and weather patterns
